description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Notify the Industrial Dispute between H. K. Nimal vs. State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka ; Jathika Sewaka Sangamaya vs. Lanka Salt Limited and A. M. D. S. Alahakoon vs. Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act. It includes the appointment of arbitrators for industrial disputes, revocation of previous orders, and statements of matters in dispute between parties. The content focuses on regulatory procedures and legal frameworks for resolving industrial disputes rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
